Grease,Ⓒs.ⒹvasA, medas n., vapA, mAMsasnehaH-sAraH.
Ⓑ
 2 snehaH, tElaM, GftaM.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹvasayA-sne-hena lip 6 P or aMj 7 P or dih 2 U.
Ⓝ[Greas]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓmedasvin, vasAmaya (yI f.), cikkaRa, pra-, snigDa, vasAkta, snehAByakta, sasneha, vasA-sneha-yukta.

Great,Ⓒa.Ⓓmahat, guru, bfhat, viSAla, vipula, vi-stIrRa, uru, pfTu, sTUla, mahApramARa.
Ⓑ
 2 (In number) bahu, BUri, pracura, bahula, bahusaM-KyAka.
Ⓑ
 3 utkfzwa, uttama, parama, viSizwa, vi-Sruta, SrezWa, labDapratizWa, prasidDa, mahAyaSaska.
Ⓑ
 4 mahecCa, mahASaya, mahAtman, udAra, udAracitta.
Ⓑ
 5 praDAna, muKya, parama, agrya, guru.
Ⓑ
 6 atyaMta, atimAtra, gAQa, aDika, BfSa, parama, ekAMta, nitAMta, atirikta; oft. by mahat, su, ati, in comp.; ‘to a g(reat) distance’, sudUraM, atidUraM; ‘to a g(reat) degree’ BfSaM, atimAtraM, atyaMtaM, nirBaraM, gAQaM.
Ⓝ[Great]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹBfSaM, atyaMtaM, sAti-SayaM, su-ni-tarAM, ekAMtataH, paraM, balavat, gAQaM, paramaM, su-ati-atiSaya in comp.; See Exceedingly; oft. ex. by kowi f., kAzWA; ‘he was g(reatly) delighted’ AnaMdasya parAM kowiM-kAzWAM-aDigatavAn.
Ⓝ[Great]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹmahattvaM, mAhAtmyaM, mahiman m., gurutvaM; vipulatA, viSAlatA, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 vistAraH, parimARaM.
Ⓑ
 3 viSruti f., utkarzaH, viSizwatA, paramatA, A-DikyaM, pratizWA, gOravaM.
Ⓑ
 4 vEBavaM, SoBA, ESvaryaM; See Grandeur; ‘g(reatness) of mind’ OdAryaM, mAhAtmyaM; ‘g(reatness) of rank’ kulInatA, aBijAtya, kulotkarzaH.

Greed,Ⓒs.ⒹloBaH, gfDnutA, atispfhA, lOlyaM, lubDatA, atyaBilAzaH, atilipsA, atyA-kAMkzA, lolupatvaM, atfpti f., aparitozaH.
Ⓑ

ⓃGreedy,Ⓒa.ⒹlubDa, lolupa, loluBa, gfDnu, loBAvizwa, atyaBilAzin, atyAkAMkzin, satfzRa, atitfzRAkula, ati-loBin.
Ⓑ
 2 AhAralubDa, atyAhArapriya, Ga-smara, admara, atiBojin, bahuBuj, Odarika, udaraMBari, kukziMBari, bahuBakzaka; ‘to be g(reedy)’ gfD 4 P, luB 4 P.
Ⓝ[Greedi]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹatiloBena, saloBaM, satfzRaM, lolupatayA, jihvAlOlyAt, atyaBilAzeRa, atispfhayA.
Ⓝ[Greedy]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹloBaH; See (s.).

Green,Ⓒa.Ⓓharita, harit, haridvarRa; pa(pA)-lASa.
Ⓑ
 2 nava, pratyagra, aBinava.
Ⓑ
 3 aparipakva, apariRata; ‘g(reen)-headed’ apariRataprajYa, apakvaDI.
Ⓔs.ⒹharidvarRaH, haritaH, harit m., pAlASavarRaH.
Ⓑ

Ⓝ[Green]ish,Ⓒa.ⒹIzadDarita, haridABa, IzatpalASa.
Ⓝ[Green]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹharitatvaM, palASatvaM.
Ⓑ
 2 apariRatatvaM, aparipAkaH, apakvatA.

Greet,Ⓒv. t.ⒹaBinaMd 1 P or c., saBAj 10, vaMd 1 A, aBivad c. (A.), arc 1 P, 10, saM-BU c., satkf 8 U, pUj 10; namaskf, praRam 1 P; ‘g(reet) in return’ pratinaMd, pratyaBi-vad c.
Ⓝ[Greet]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹpraRAmaH, praRati f., aBivaMdanaM, aBinaMdanaM, namaskAraH, aBivAdaH-vAdanaM, kuSalavAdaH-praSnaH.
